title: Viral Genetic Diversity and Evolutionary Dynamics: Mechanisms, Analysis, and Clinical Implications for Drug Development
description: A comprehensive examination of the mechanisms generating viral genetic diversity, the evolutionary relationships shaping viral populations, and the modern methodologies used for their analysis. The review focuses on the clinical implications of viral evolution, such as drug resistance, and how these insights inform the development of new therapeutics and public health strategies.
audience: Researchers, Virologists, Drug Development Professionals, Public Health Officials
